blocks.text:
To: Barbara Blair
Cc: Kelly Snyder, Heather Munoz
That works, and it matches how we planned to run it. Once your descriptions are in, I will scope the searches to the features Heather Munoz asked you to flag and take those first.

In the meantime, Kelly Snyder has the reference set open and is clearing the broad searches, so we lose no time on the general landscape for {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} while we wait on the specifics. The one thing holding the next step is the descriptions and the priority list. Send them whenever they are ready and I will fold them straight in.
